context:
Goal: ship the Card in Hand tap fix with a test that proves no row moves under the finger.
Problem (rule): the tapped row's label moved 10 pt sideways; it is fixed (3ea0bdc). No check of its horizontal position can go red: a static-text read fails on every build, and a pixel scan (307f3cf) passed a mutant with the shift. The reviewer calls deleting the check a weakened test, which needs your ruling.
Based on (measured): Duo 1 runs on 2026-11-07 at 14:46 and 16:35 CST.
Based on (read): the rule that a test is never weakened to reach green.
Based on (read): the design review (design-reviewer opus, 18:04 CST) passes the label from screenshots on Duo 1. When a match is tapped, the name stays in place and only the accent bar appears in the gutter. That holds for the open pose in light theme only.
Departs from: main has no Card in Hand tap-hold — adds the tap-hold fix without a test of the label's horizontal position.
Unvetted: the past-ruling check timed out (model subprocess), so this was not checked against past rulings.
Also sent to the coordinator at 16:38 CST; an answer there counts the same.
holds: Both Duo lanes wait to reach the batch until this is answered.
home: decision duo-card-in-hand; debt hand-tap-label-unpinned (branch hand-tap-shift 6a1ae0c, landing at merge)

lastAnswer.note: ok (owner in chat with the coordinator)

options.gain: Both Duo lanes reach the batch now.
options.how: The fix ships, a debt names the missing check, and the design review judges the label from screenshots.
options.label: Ship without that check, and open a debt
options.lose: A later sideways label shift would pass the tests.

options.gain: The shift is pinned by a test.
options.how: The lane keeps trying new checks until one catches the shift.
options.label: Keep building a check that goes red
options.lose: More test rounds and Duo slots with no end date; both lanes wait.

ref: fix 3ea0bdc (tapped row's label no longer moves); pixel-scan check 307f3cf (passed a mutant with the shift); Duo 1 runs 2026-11-07 14:46 and 16:35 CST
title: No test can catch Card in Hand's 10 pt label shift. Ship the fix without that check?
why: The fix is in and the design review still sees the label; two kinds of check have already failed to go red.
